notes.title: Explore Mode Expanded – 3 New Dinosaurs Added!
notes.notes:
Explore Mode just got an exciting upgrade!

We’ve added three new prehistoric creatures for you to encounter up close:

Parasaurolophus – A majestic herbivore with a signature crest.

Ankylosaurus – A slow-moving tank with heavy armor and a deadly tail.

Dimetrodon – A fierce predator from the Permian period, now roaming free.

Take your time, enjoy the scenery, and get up close with these amazing creatures in a non-combat experience. Whether you're studying their movements or just enjoying the immersive world, Explore Mode is the perfect place to connect with the past.

📢 Available now – jump into Explore Mode and meet your new dino companions!

notes.title: The Hunt Evolves: New Dinosaurs Are Coming Soon
notes.notes:
🦖 Coming Soon: 3 New Dinosaurs Roar into Action!
Get ready, hunters – a new wave of prehistoric beasts is approaching fast!

In the upcoming update, you’ll face off against:

Parasaurolophus – A towering herbivore with a haunting call and massive crest.

Ankylosaurus – Armored to the teeth and ready to swing its clubbed tail with force.

Dimetrodon – Not technically a dino, but this sail-backed predator doesn’t care – it’s here to dominate.

Sharpen your skills and gear up – the hunt is about to get wild.
📅 Update coming soon. Stay tuned!
